title: Cyrus and the Compass
author: Sebastian Ravensworth
blurb: Noor Ashgrove, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
